UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information and regional preferences for AgriSathi farmers.

userId.description: Unique Firebase Authentication UID of the user.

location.description: District or region in Assam (e.g. Rangia, Kamrup).

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the user profile was created.

CropLogEntry.title: CropLogEntry
CropLogEntry.description: Saved leaf disease diagnosis record tracked by the farmer in their field diary.

id.description: Unique identifier for this diagnosis log record.

userId.description: UID of the farmer who logged the diagnosis.

crop.description: Name of the crop (e.g. Rice, Potato, Tomato, Paddy).

disease.description: Diagnosed disease or condition (e.g. Leaf blast, Late blight).

pathogen.description: Pathogen classification group (e.g. Fungus, Bacteria, Algae, None).

confidence.description: Model confidence percentage from visual inference.

status.description: Current recovery status of the crop.

imageUrl.description: Optional image data URL or preview link of the specimen.

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp or server timestamp when the log entry was created.

ChatMessage.title: ChatMessage
ChatMessage.description: A single conversational turn between the farmer and AgriSathi AI.

source.description: Model source, such as gemini-3.8-flash or offline-dataset.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores individual farmer profiles and preferences.

/users/{userId}/cropLogs/{logId}.description: Stores crop diagnosis records saved by the user.

/users/{userId}/chatMessages/{messageId}.description: Stores persistent conversation history for the user.
